signals.text: At Cheddington Combined School, our school values of honesty, excellence, appreciation, respect and teamwork are extremely important to us and are at the heart of everything that the children learn.
Inclusivity and Equity: Our PSHE curriculum is designed to foster an inclusive and equitable learning environment where every pupil's identity, experiences, and perspectives are valued and respected.
Our teachers not only have excellent subject knowledge but are also skilled facilitators who create a safe and supportive learning environment.
We are a happy, ambitious, and dedicated single form entry primary school that values the love of learning and enriching the curriculum.

signals.text: Impact Our PSHE curriculum has a profound and lasting impact on our pupils, enabling them to develop the knowledge, skills, and attitudes necessary for personal well-being, positive relationships, and active citizenship.
We have a dedicated team of staff members who provide support, advice, and guidance to pupils, fostering a positive school climate where mental health and emotional well-being are prioritised.
Well-Being and Pastoral Care: Our PSHE curriculum is complemented by a strong focus on well-being and pastoral care.

We recognize and celebrate diversity in all its forms, ensuring our curriculum is sensitive to cultural, social, and individual differences.

"Cheddington is a happy school, which is full of joy and laughter" Ofsted July 2025
Welcome from our Headteacher
Welcome to our wonderful school!
We are a happy, ambitious, and dedicated single-form entry primary school that values the love of learning and enriching the curriculum.
Situated in the heart of the village, we are lucky to have a beautiful site which allows us to learn creatively whilst also learning important life skills.
Our team of highly dedicated staff provide our children with exciting lessons that motivate and inspire our children to develop a lifelong love of learning. We are continuing to develop our rich and varied curriculum centred on our children’s needs.
In partnership with Kidszone, we are able to offer wrap-around care, both before and after school. We also offer a wide range of extracurricular clubs for our children, including sports clubs, musical theatre and art.

Extra Curricular Activites/Wrap-around care
We understand that modern life is very busy and that sometimes 'wrap-around' care is necessary. We are pleased to be able to facilitate the following provision run by Kidz Zone:
Morning Activity Club at school is from 7.35am until 8.30am each morning.
After School Club from 3.15am until 5.30pm (Fridays finish at 4.30pm).
For Morning Activity Club, children have a choice of activities. Breakfast in the form of cereals, toast and juice is included. The cost is 7.35-8.30am £5.80 7.45-8.30am £4.80.
The After School Club offers a range of activities, which are varied each day and a snack for those children staying beyond 4.15pm. Prices start from £6.50 For more details or to book, please visit their website: https://www.kidzzoneclub.com/

pageCache.text:
Welcome from our Headteacher​​​​​​​
Welcome to our wonderful school!
We are a happy, ambitious, and dedicated single form entry primary school that values the love of learning and enriching the curriculum.
Situated in the heart of the village, we are lucky to have a beautiful site which allows us to learn creatively whilst also learning important life skills.
Our team of highly dedicated staff provide our children with exciting lessons that motive and inspire our children to develop a lifelong love of learning. We are continuing to develop our rich and varied curriculum centred on our children’s needs.
In partnership with Kidszone we are able to offer wrap around care, both before and after school. We also offer a wide range of extra-curricular clubs for our children including sports clubs, musical theatre and art.
For further information about our school please contact our school office on 01296 668324. Visits are welcome by appointment.
